texts.title: Checking your bicycle before a ride

paragraphs.text: Before every ride, it is worth checking a few parts of your bicycle. Start with the tyres: press them with your thumb, and if they feel soft, pump them up to the pressure printed on the side.
Next, check the brakes. Squeeze each brake lever on the handlebars and make sure the brake pads touch the wheel rim evenly and firmly.
Look at the chain. It should be clean and lightly oiled; a dry or rusty chain makes pedalling harder and wears out faster.
Finally, adjust the saddle so that your leg is almost straight when the pedal is at its lowest point, and make sure the front and rear lights work if you ride after dark.

If you find a problem you cannot fix yourself, most bike shops offer a quick safety check, and some community workshops will show you how to do simple repairs. It is also a good idea to carry a small pump.

items.quote: Start with the tyres: press them with your thumb

explanation.en: The pressure is printed on the tyres: “Start with the tyres” → tyres (“tyre” / “tire” also accepted).
explanation.kk: Қысым шинаның бүйірінде жазылған: «Start with the tyres» → tyres (tyre / tire да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: Давление напечатано сбоку на шинах: «Start with the tyres» → tyres (засчитываются и tyre / tire).

items.quote: Squeeze each brake lever on the handlebars

explanation.en: “each brake lever on the handlebars” → lever. “Brake” is already in the label.
explanation.kk: «each brake lever on the handlebars» → lever. «Brake» жазуда тұр.
explanation.ru: «each brake lever on the handlebars» → lever. «Brake» уже в подписи.

items.quote: make sure the brake pads touch the wheel rim evenly and firmly

explanation.en: Next to the rim are the brake pads: “make sure the brake pads touch the wheel rim”. Answer: pads, plural.
explanation.kk: Дөңгелек шеңберінің жанында — тежегіш қалыптары: «make sure the brake pads touch the wheel rim». Жауап pads, көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: У обода колеса — тормозные колодки: «make sure the brake pads touch the wheel rim». Ответ pads, во множественном числе.

items.quote: It should be clean and lightly oiled

explanation.en: Paragraph 3 is about the chain: “It should be clean and lightly oiled”. Part 4 is on the lower frame where the chain runs. Answer: chain.
explanation.kk: 3-абзац шынжыр туралы: «It should be clean and lightly oiled». Сызбада 4-бөлік — шынжыр өтетін төменгі рамада. Жауап chain.
explanation.ru: В абзаце 3 про цепь: «It should be clean and lightly oiled». На схеме часть 4 — у нижней рамы, где проходит цепь. Ответ chain.

items.quote: adjust the saddle so that your leg is almost straight

explanation.en: “adjust the saddle so that your leg is almost straight” → saddle. The “pedal” is mentioned, but it is the saddle you adjust.
explanation.kk: «adjust the saddle so that your leg is almost straight» → saddle. «Pedal» да аталады, бірақ ерді реттейді.
explanation.ru: «adjust the saddle so that your leg is almost straight» → saddle. «Pedal» тоже упомянута, но регулируют седло.
